items.headline: Mangaluru: MLA Jayanarayan, a leader from a political lineage, attacked
items.blurb: Mangaluru MLA and corporator Jayanarayan was attacked in Bunder wards, hospitalised with injuries after the Monday incident.

items.headline: Minor girl sexually harassed in Mangaluru; 17 accused from two colleges
items.blurb: Police booked 17 people from two Mangaluru colleges, some minors, after a minor girl's October 8 sexual harassment complaint.

items.headline: DC warns hospitals against denying initial treatment to snakebite victims
items.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner Darshan H V warned hospitals of legal action for denying immediate snakebite care; the district recorded 365 cases in 2023 and 527 through September 2025.

items.headline: Govt. suppressing voice of students through police: Mangaluru City MLAs
items.blurb: Mangaluru City MLAs Vedavyasa Kamath and Bharat Shetty alleged police manhandled students peacefully seeking postponement of exams during Dasara, including at St. Agnes College where a memorandum was not accepted.

items.headline: Hoax call triggers Mangaluru airport scare
items.blurb: A hoax call caused a security scare at Mangaluru airport.

items.headline: Uttara Kannada: 3 minors killed in hill collapse at stone quarry
items.blurb: Three minors were killed in an Uttara Kannada stone-quarry hill collapse.

items.headline: Udupi: MGS Hospital workers protest CM's pre-closure announcement
items.blurb: Udupi MGS Hospital staff protested CM Siddaramaiah's October 7 pre-closure order, citing two years without pay and a 21-day hunger strike by about 50 workers demanding compensation before shutdown.

items.headline: Report sought on delay in UGD project in Kundapur
items.blurb: Balakrishna ordered a report on the 11-year delay in Kundapur’s ₹56.54 crore underground drainage project.

items.headline: Two electrocuted, minor injured in Sullia
items.blurb: Two persons, Bharath (28) and Ramesh (35), died and a minor boy suffered burns after contact with a live wire fence at farmland in Sullia taluk.

items.headline: Udupi gets state's first 'fully literate district' tag
items.blurb: The state government declared Udupi Karnataka’s first fully literate district with literacy above 95%.

items.headline: 4 kids killed as truck hits them in Bengaluru
items.blurb: Four children were killed after a truck struck them in Bengaluru.

items.headline: Farmers' stir holds up traffic on busy Pune-B'luru highway
items.blurb: KRRS and Hasiru Sene farmers blocked the Pune–Bengaluru highway at Hattargi toll plaza in Belagavi demanding ₹6,000 per tonne for sugarcane.

items.headline: 108 ambulance workers threaten strike from tonight
items.blurb: Health Minister U.T. Khader said only about 350 of 750 required 108 ambulances were operational and urged the public not to depend solely on the service for two months as the 108 Ambulance Workers’ Union threatened a strike over wages, staffing and safety.

items.headline: IAS officer booked for assault on police
items.blurb: Police booked Andhra Pradesh cadre IAS officer Vikas Marmat, special officer of the Koppal Area Development Authority, and three others for allegedly assaulting a police inspector and personnel at a bar on Residency Road, Bengaluru.

items.headline: Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge verdict
items.blurb: The Karnataka government said it would explore legal options after the High Court struck down enhancement of reservation quotas for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, with Deputy CM D.K. Shivakumar and Home Minister G. Parameshwara involved in discussions.

items.headline: Top court registers Rahul’s plea on SIR, CEC
items.blurb: The Supreme Court registered Rahul Gandhi’s petition seeking a court-monitored probe into the SIR and Chief Election Commissioner appointment process.

items.headline: Shah warns Rahul of ‘crushing defeat’ in 2029
items.blurb: Union Home Minister Amit Shah dismissed the Opposition’s protests over the SIR and the Election Commission, warning Rahul Gandhi and the I.N.D.I.A. bloc of a crushing defeat in the 2029 polls and saying voters have rejected their narrative.

items.headline: 13 children killed in Bihar boat capsize
items.blurb: At least 13 children died when a boat capsized in the Ganga in Vaishali district, Bihar, according to reports from Patna.

items.headline: China says ‘never recognised’ U.T. of Ladakh; India hits back
items.blurb: China opposed the Survey of India standardising names in Ladakh and said it never recognised the Union Territory; India said no denial could change established facts.

items.headline: UPI fee rollout put off beyond Deepavali on traders’ appeal
items.blurb: NPCI postponed merchant discount rate charges on UPI beyond Deepavali after traders’ appeals, T.C.A. Sharad Raghavan reports.

items.headline: Modi holds ‘warm and productive’ talks with Canadian PM
items.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke by phone with Canadian PM Mark Carney about strengthening bilateral ties, trade and technology; Carney is expected to visit India in December.

items.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes oil facilities in Yemen
items.blurb: The Saudi-led coalition bombed Houthi-controlled oil sites near Sanaa as Houthis renewed warnings against flights in Saudi airspace.

items.headline: Pak successfully test-fires hypersonic missile
items.blurb: Pakistan test-fired the Fatah-2ER guided rocket system with 400 km range for precision long-range targets.

items.headline: FlyDubai ‘plot’: 2 Maldivian pilots detained
items.blurb: UAE police detained two Maldivian FlyDubai pilots over an alleged plot to hijack and crash a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight.

items.headline: Quad officials discuss regional resilience, cyber security
items.blurb: India, Australia, the US and Japan officials met in Singapore on a free and open Indo-Pacific, resilience and cyber security.

items.headline: India and WI willow-wielders glove up for another blast
items.blurb: India and West Indies meet in Hyderabad one win from sealing the T20I series after Shreyas Iyer’s century and Arshdeep Singh’s three wickets in Indore.

items.headline: Gill wins a record fifth ICC PotM award; Shafali, too, tops
items.blurb: Shubman Gill won a record fifth ICC Men’s Player of the Month award and Shafali Verma took the women’s award after Asia Cup performances.

items.headline: Hazlewood bowls Australia to victory
items.blurb: Josh Hazlewood’s bowling helped Australia beat South Africa in a limited-overs match.

items.headline: Goalkeeper Pathak returns, Asiad core retained for ACT
items.blurb: Hockey selectors retained the Asian Games core and recalled goalkeeper Pathak for the Asian Champions Trophy squad.

items.headline: Yuvraj appointed Delhi Capitals assistant and batting coach
items.blurb: Yuvraj Singh joined Delhi Capitals as assistant and batting coach for the 2027 IPL under head coach Sourav Ganguly.
